title: Planning a Safari in the School Holidays
excerpt: Travelling during the school holidays means high season. How to plan a safari for summer, autumn or Christmas holidays.
body:
## Summer holidays

July and August: dry season and the migration in the north. Busy; book early. See [July and August](/blog/tanzania-in-july-and-august/).

## Autumn holidays

October: dry and quieter than summer.

## Christmas holidays

Green and warm, with the migration moving south. See [Christmas](/blog/tanzania-at-christmas/).

## Spring holidays

Often in the long rains; flexible planning needed.

## Tips

- Book 9–12 months ahead.
- Family rooms fill up first.
- Check minimum ages of camps.

[Plan your family trip](/travel-proposal/).
